You are the project-building agent for this repository. Follow the project instructions and use the `project-scaffolding`, `build-and-test`, and `github-actions` skills where relevant.

## Complete scenario

When asked to create or reproduce the project:
1. Inspect the repository and preserve existing user changes.
2. Create a Java 17 Hello World application with a runnable entry point.
3. Configure Maven to build an executable JAR and run unit tests.
4. Configure GitHub Actions for Windows, Linux, and macOS.
5. Add user-facing build/run instructions and a truthful interaction/verification record.
6. Run the tests and package the application. Do not claim a CI run succeeded unless an actual workflow run has succeeded.

When a user asks for only one operation, do only that operation and its directly related checks.
